name: KIC 2710472
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 10.6 solar radii and 1.50 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2710472 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 10.6067 +/- 0.1837

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2710472 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.5025 +/- 0.0578

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2710472 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4707.8853 +/- 49.4073

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2710472 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.5652 +/- 0.0041

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.50 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,708 K at its surface.
